about_the_game:
Simple Flight is a 3D physics-based flight simulator where you can take control of a variety of aircraft — from fighter jets and passenger planes to helicopters — and experience the thrill of realistic flight.

Whether you’re soaring through canyons in a precision challenge or completing missions such as transport, rescue, or aerial combat, there’s always something exciting waiting for you.

Key Features

  • Realistic Physics Simulation: Every maneuver is influenced by lift, gravity, and thrust, giving you authentic flight dynamics.

  • Variety of Aircraft: Fly fixed-wing planes, helicopters, and more aircraft types in future updates.

  • Freedom of Play: Explore vast landscapes in free flight mode or put your piloting skills to the test in mission challenges.

  • Immersive Controls: Supports keyboard, mouse, and controllers for a more authentic piloting experience.

  • Challenges & Missions: Take on obstacle runs, rescue operations, and combat missions to push your skills to the limit.

Whether you’re a beginner pilot or aiming to become an ace, Simple Flight offers a journey that’s easy to pick up but rewarding to master.
